name: Improved version of filament bend preventer

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a filament bend preventer designed as a truncated cone with a wide bottom base and a narrow top. A small, vertical cylindrical hole runs through the exact center of the cone to guide the filament. On two opposite sides of the cone, large cylindrical cuts have been made to create clearance, resulting in scooped-out curved slopes that break the uniform conical shape.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric filament bend preventer in OpenSCAD based on a truncated cone. The user should be able to adjust the bottom radius (r1), top radius (r2), height (h), and central hole radius (r3), along with two offset side-cutout radii (r4 and r5) and their respective clearance heights (clear1 and clear2) to accommodate hotend components.
captions.factory: The design is built using a difference() boolean operation on a main cylinder. The main body is a truncated cone defined by 'cylinder(r1=r1, r2=r2, h=h)'. A central vertical cylinder of radius 'r3' is subtracted to create the filament guide hole. Two additional cylinders of radii 'r4' and 'r5' are rotated 90 degrees, translated to their respective clearance heights and offsets on opposite sides, and subtracted to form the curved side cutouts.
